body: A `ValidationStateEntry.Metadata` override on the union object itself is ignored here. For example, assigning `GetMetadataForType(typeof(object))` to a `ValidatableUnion` entry still takes this branch solely because the runtime model implements `IUnion`, then the synthetic `Value` child is traversed and the invalid case is reported. `ValidationStateEntry.Metadata` is documented to override validation behavior, and existing callers use it to force traversal as a specified type. Gate the union strategy on the effective `Metadata.ModelType` (including nullable unions), not only the runtime object, so an override to `object` remains authoritative; please cover the union-level/nested-union override as well.

The PR description says `Fixes #68268`, but that issue is specifically about `ValidationsGenerator`, is already closed as fixed by #68846, and this diff only changes MVC model validation. Remove the closing reference (while retaining the link to the MVC report) so this PR is not recorded as fixing unrelated generator work.

This new `ContainerType.GetProperty` lookup is failing the shared-framework linkability check with IL2075: `ContainerType` doesn't carry the `PublicProperties` annotation required by `GetProperty`. See [build 1635250](https://dev.azure.com/dnceng-public/public/_build/results?buildId=1635250).

MVC already declares trimming unsupported, so this looks like another member-scoped entry for `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc.Core.WarningSuppressions.xml`.

Non-blocking: `Metadata` is still null on the initial property-validation call with `container: union`. This requires explicitly validating one property of a custom `IUnion`, or binding a property on a controller/page that itself implements `IUnion`. Normal whole-model validation, including the new `LengthUnion` test, is unaffected.

There is no parent metadata override to check on that initial call:

```suggestion
            (Metadata is null ||
                typeof(IUnion).IsAssignableFrom(Nullable.GetUnderlyingType(Metadata.ModelType) ?? Metadata.ModelType)))
```
